title: Assert canonical note-search scan costs and measure live-store search
outcome: The eligible canonical note scan has executable cost regression assertions and an attributed measurement on a snapshot of a representative live store.
acceptance: The existing note-search cost fixture asserts meaningful decode/query bounds derived from eligible item and note counts, detecting ineligible scans or repeated loads rather than merely printing cost.

Record reproducible search and continuation timing/cost on a supported snapshot copy of a live store, with workload counts, producer/source identity and command/result evidence; keep scratch inside the owning repository worktree and leave the live store unchanged.

completion.summary: Added executable eligible canonical decode/query regression bounds and reproducible supported live-store-copy search/continuation measurement with attributed producers and limits.
